name: Verify Agentforce-created ticket is marked with Source = Agentforce
objective: Validate that tickets created via the AI Assistant have the Source field set to 'Agentforce' and channel stored as 'Portal'.
precondition: User is logged in, on home page, AI Assistant panel is open.

steps.description: Click the Agentforce icon and create a ticket through the assistant
steps.expectedResult: A ticket is created successfully with incident number displayed

steps.description: Navigate to the created ticket record
steps.testData: Click the incident link or open the ticket in the system

steps.description: Verify the Source field is set to 'Agentforce'
Verify the originating channel is stored as 'Portal'
